text:
maya (PM): Quick sync — proposing a staggered rollout plan for region-based feature flags + fallback lift criteria for the routing change. TL;DR: 3-stage canary (internal, regional beta, all-regions) with automated fallback on p99 > 200ms or error rate delta > 1.5% for 5m.

eric (Eng): +1. Can we clarify sample sizes for the A/B test? Need enough traffic to validate cost/latency tradeoffs.

maya (PM): Proposed sampling:
1) Internal: 100% infra team traffic (smoke)
2) Regional beta: 2% global traffic in 2 non-overlapping regions (~50qps)
3) Ramp: 10% then 25% over 24h windows
We want at least 10k requests per phase for metrics stability.

samira (SRE): Metrics to watch: p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, tail CPU/GPU util, retry count, token cost delta. Alert if p99 increases by >20ms and 5xx increases by >0.5pp.

jordan (Ops): How do we lift fallback? Do we allow automatic rollback or require manual approve at 25%?

maya (PM): Plan: automated rollback on hard SLO breaches (p99>200ms or 5xx>1.5%) for 5m sustained. Soft warnings (p99 up 10-20ms) raise to oncall and pause ramp; manual approve to continue. Add kill-switch in console.

eric (Eng): Config snippet for the flag:
```
flag: routing-experiment-v3
phases:
  - name: internal
    pct: 0.5
  - name: regional-beta
    pct: 2
    regions: [eu-west-1, us-east-1]
  - name: ramp
    pct: 10 -> 25 over 24h
fallback: "fallback-variant-v2"
metrics: [p99_latency_ms, error_rate, cost_per_token]
```

samira (SRE): Add a canary perf job that runs synthetic sessions every minute targeting known heavy prompts. If any session hits >500ms for >3 samples in 5m, trigger rollback.

maya (PM): Customer ask (FinRegCo): require geo-pin for regulated EU traffic and longer observation window (48h) before 25% ramp. Approving? @eric @samira

eric (Eng): Fine with geo-pin. We'll add policy: eu traffic stays on pinned variant until EU 25% has 48h of green metrics.

jordan (Ops): Rollout playbook notes:
- Preflight: load test at 2x expected regional QPS
- Runbook: how to flip fallback, telegram/ops channel ops-urgent
- Postmortem: collect sample prompts and evals

maya (PM): Launch criteria checklist:
- Metrics green for 24h at 10% and 48h for EU exception
- No regressor in generation quality eval (automated eval pass)
- Runbook posted, oncall scheduled

deploy-bot: Deployment triggered: canary job queued for routing-experiment-v3 at 1934567920 :white_check_mark:

eric (Eng): Ok starting canary. I'll post interim results in this thread. :rocket:
